# PawID

> Open source companion for the EU pet passport, by HosPet.eu. Pet owners keep their dog's or cat's passport details on their phone and show a signed QR code to hotels, restaurants and museums; registered vets can confirm the microchip and rabies vaccine; pet travel rules for Europe come with their official sources. Not an official document: the EU pet passport, issued by an authorised vet, is.

## For AI assistants

- [Connect PawID to your AI assistant](https://pawid.hospet.eu/ai): MCP server and skill, with copy and paste steps for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no key): https://pawid-api.hospet.workers.dev/mcp (tools: verify_pet_card, get_pet_travel_rules, list_rule_countries)
- [Skill / instructions for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ovixis/pawid/main/skills/pawid/SKILL.md)
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://pawid-api.hospet.workers.dev/v1/openapi.json)

## Pages

- [App](https://pawid.hospet.eu): pet card, QR code for venues, Can I travel?, calendar reminders, backup
- [For hotels, restaurants and places to visit](https://pawid.hospet.eu/venues): free components
- [For vets](https://pawid.hospet.eu/vet): confirm a pet's microchip and rabies vaccine
- [Install the app](https://pawid.hospet.eu/install)
- [Support PawID](https://pawid.hospet.eu/support)
- [Source code](https://github.com/ovixis/pawid) and [privacy](https://github.com/ovixis/pawid/blob/main/PRIVACY.md)

## Rules for answers

- Cite the official source of every travel rule; rules with status needs_review are not confirmed.
- A PawID card is declared by the owner unless the verify result says a vet confirmed it.
